title: Mortblock
description: High-performance Fabric Skyblock utility. Solvers, Mining & Garden QoL. Built for fair play on latest MC versions.
body:
🛡️ Mortblock: Modern Skyblock Utility
Fabric-Based | Latest Versions | 100% Legit & Safe
Mortblock is a curated Fabric modpack built for the latest versions of Minecraft. It focuses on providing essential visual aids and performance boosts while staying strictly within the Hypixel rules.

🚀 Main Features
⚔️ Dungeons & Combat
Includes essential Solvers to help you navigate puzzles and trap rooms efficiently. Stay on top of the action with clear visual indicators without breaking the immersion or the server rules.

⛏️ Mining
Experience a completely overhauled Mining UI. Track your commissions, heat levels, and powder progress with a clean, modern interface designed for the latest Minecraft versions.

🌿 Farming & Garden
Enhanced tools for the Garden and Greenhouse. Visual guides and QoL mods help you maintain your farm and track your milestones with ease.

✨ Quality of Life (QoL)
Packed with numerous QoL mods that fix common annoyances, improve inventory management, and provide better information displays for all Skyblock skills.

🧪 Beta & Feedback
Mortblock is currently in Beta. Since it's running on the latest Fabric versions, your feedback is crucial!

Got an idea? Let us know what features you want to see.

Found a bug? Please report it so we can keep the pack stable.

✅ Safe & Fair Play
Mortblock is built with compliance in mind. All included mods are strictly Quality of Life and visual aids. There are no macros, no "cheats," and no automation. This pack is designed to be 100% in line with Hypixel’s "Use at your own risk" policy, focusing only on allowed modifications.
